descriptions.preferred: Like other members of the 'Shigitatsu sawa' group of cultivars, 'Ariadne' has marbled leaves in contrasting colors to the network of veins. New growth is especially attractive with yellow-green veining on a light orange-pink-red marbled background. Leaf color gradually changes to become red-veined on a purplish-red background by late summer. In the fall, the veins are yellow-green on an orange-pinkred marbled background with a deeper pink-red Acer spreading inward from the margins. This cultivar Gregory. also has attractive green young stems with fine, closely packed glaucous striations and lovely red fruits. The large fiveto seven-lobed leaves are very deeply cut. The narrowly ovate lobes have tail-like tips and coarsely, sharply pointed toothed margins. 'Ariadne' matures to a shrub 10 ft. (3 m) tall and at least as wide. The name honors a granddaughter of D. M. van Gelderen, whose nursery introduced this plant.

sources.title: 女神/阿里阿德 Acer Palmatum 'Ariadne'
sources.description: 阿里阿德涅由荷兰埃斯维尔德苗圃引进，以科尔的女儿命名，简称为阿里阿德。阿里阿德涅是一款非常经典的脉叶品种，叶片上的叶脉清晰，结构像一个迷宫，在希腊神话中，女神阿里阿德涅恰好是迷宫的女主人，所以在国内也称它为女神。 初春时节，新叶是粉红色、橙色和黄色的，每片叶子都有明亮的绿色叶脉，叶子在夏季变为浅绿色，光照良好的条件下还会保留一部分粉色，与深绿色叶脉形成鲜明的对比，秋天整棵树上的叶子会变成火红色，然后在落叶前转变为红色。一般为 5-7 叶裂，叶裂较深，叶形是狭窄的卵状，叶边缘有比较明显且锋利的锯齿，成年树高约 3m 左右。 阿里阿德涅因其随着季节不断变化的色彩而备受赞誉，环境不同色彩表现差别较大，甚至在同一棵树上，由于光照条件不同，色彩层次也很鲜明。加之长势较好，在花园、庭院中经常扮演着非常重要的角色。作为抗性色彩兼优的品种，非常推荐，相信它必定会吸引所有人的注意。

rhs.description: A spreading shrub or small tree to 3m tall with deeply cut, 5-7-lobed leaves, emerging coppery orange-pink with green veins, becoming purplish red with red veins in summer and then orange-pink in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 与 'Shigitatsu sawa' 品种群的其他成员一样，'Ariadne' 的叶片具有大理石般的斑纹，叶脉网络与叶面底色形成鲜明对比。新梢尤其美观，在浅橙粉红至红色的大理石纹底色上分布着黄绿色叶脉。到夏末，叶色逐渐变化为紫红色底上带红色叶脉。秋季时，叶脉呈黄绿色，底色为橙粉红色大理石纹，且有更深的粉红红色自叶缘向内扩展。该品种还具有迷人的绿色幼枝，其上有细密排列的粉白色条纹，并结有美丽的红色果实。叶片较大，通常为 5 至 7 裂，裂刻很深；裂片狭卵形，先端呈尾状，叶缘具粗而尖锐的锯齿。'Ariadne' 成熟后为灌木，高约 10 英尺（3 米），冠幅至少相当。其名称是为纪念 D. M. van Gelderen 的一位孙女，该植物由其苗圃引种推出。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 造型植物、城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低养护、庭院/容器植物

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 开展型灌木或小乔木，株高可达 3 米；叶深裂，5 至 7 裂，萌叶时呈铜橙粉色并带绿色叶脉，夏季转为紫红色并具红色叶脉，秋季则呈橙粉色。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖
